# Epic Optimization — Phase 2

- **Goal / definition of done:** after Phase 1 stabilizes, tune workflows and roll out new Epic
  modules — most importantly the **bed-management / capacity-command module** — then extend Epic
  to the remaining hospitals and clinics.
- **Owner:** [Wei Chen](../people/wei-chen.md).
- **Status (current):** **planning / not yet started;** kickoff is gated on Phase 1
  demobilization (~2026-08-01). Scoping underway.
- **Key deliverable:** the **bed-management module** is the dependency that
  [ED Throughput Improvement](ed-throughput.md) is waiting on to attack inpatient boarding.

## Not to be confused with
- [Epic EHR Go-Live — Phase 1](epic-golive-phase-1.md) — the initial flagship go-live, already
  **live and in stabilization**. Phase 2 is the **follow-on optimization** program.
